name: Admin product create edit search and soft delete
description: Verify backend-integrated product management with unique SKU, dynamic image fallback, editing, public visibility, and soft deletion.

planSteps.description: Log in as admin@rafstore.id with Admin#Raf2026 and open /admin/produk/baru.

Create a product using unique SKU TS-AUTO-20260716, name TestSprite Auto Product, category QA, description Produk otomatis untuk verifikasi TestSprite, price 123456, stock 5, and image URL https://google.com.
Verify the product is persisted, appears in admin search, shows stock 5, and renders the image-unavailable fallback without crashing.
Open edit for TestSprite Auto Product, unlock SKU, change name to TestSprite Auto Product Updated and price to 123457, then save.
Verify the updated values persist and the product appears in the public catalog.
Return to admin products, search for TS-AUTO-20260716, delete the product, and confirm deletion.
Verify it disappears from admin active products and the public catalog due to soft deletion.
